title: Destroy All Doors Open Source
features:
Destroy all doors

Doors:
VIP Door
Premium Door
Timer Door2
Timer Door1
script:
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local possibleDoorNames = {"VIPDoor", "PremiumDoor", "Timer2", "Timer1"}

for _, doorName in ipairs(possibleDoorNames) do
    local door = workspace:FindFirstChild(doorName, true)
    if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
        door:Destroy()
    elseif door and door:IsA("Model") then
        for _, part in ipairs(door:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end
